title: Mixed Event — Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles — Episode1 It's Almost Valentine's Day!

meta.Event: Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles
meta.Event Outline: Ichika and Nene aren't sure what to give for Valentine's Day. They ask Honami for some advice and decide to make some scented candles together. Meanwhile, Kanade, who has the same concern, also asks Honami for help...

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(School's finally out...
This day felt so long for some reason.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Is it because I'm just that excited about having singing practice with Kusanagi?)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Valentine's Day is coming up!
I can't wait to share chocolates with everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Valentine's Day...
It's already that time of year.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'd like to give something to Miku and the others... But what would be best?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, actually, I think the mall's having a Valentine's Day fair. That might be a good place to look.)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: What are you gonna make? I wanna try my hand at baking a chocolate tart.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
You are...?
I was thinking about being lazy and just buying some...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
What?! Why?!
If we're gonna exchange them, they should all be homemade!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: They don't absolutely have to be homemade. I mean, store-bought ones just look better and more appetizing, you know?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I get what you mean...
But homemade means that there's just that much more love baked into them, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (More love baked into them...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I agree that a homemade gift would do a better job of showing someone just how much you appreciate them as opposed to a store-bought one...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(But what would I make...?
I don't really know how to bake sweets or anything...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(No, now's not the time for this.
I need to hurry. I shouldn't keep Kusanagi waiting!)
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...
H-How was that...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Really good.
I thought you also did well at Shibuya Festa, but you seem to just keep getting better and better.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You already had such a clear, refined voice, but it's like it's become even more refined...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm guessing that you feel a lot more confident about your singing now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... S-Sorry, I didn't mean to sound uppity...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
Actually, that made me really happy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean, it's hard for me to tell how my singing is changing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And it means a lot coming from you, Kusanagi. I feel like I've grown quite a bit now, so thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: At the same time, I should also be thanking you... I've learned so much by practicing with you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, you have...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Whenever I practice with you, I notice things that I don't normally...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's so nice to be able to practice singing with someone else outside of the Wonder Stage like this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...? Then, I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway... Wanna try singing together next?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes! Oh, but... I'd like to get something to drink first. All this singing has made me parched.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I think I'd like something as well. There's a convenience store just right there, so let's head over together.
se_event_candle_2023_005

rows.Speaker: Convenience Store Clerk
rows.Line: Thank you, have a nice day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad that we were able to get some drinks, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That store...
It was covered with Valentine's Day merchandise.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There were so many different chocolates on display in front of the register too. I guess it really is just around the corner.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That reminds me of some girls who I overheard talking about Valentine's today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When I heard them talking, I began thinking about what I'm going to do, but couldn't really come to a decision.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, are you planning on giving some gifts to people?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, my bandmates.
But I don't really know how to bake sweets or anything, so I initially thought about just buying something from the store...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But one of those girls said how it'd be more meaningful if you made a gift yourself... So, I sort of want to do that instead.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see...
I think I'm in the same boat as you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, Kusanagi, you too?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I also initially thought that something store-bought would be fine... However, after rehearsal yesterday, we started talking about Valentine's Day...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Isn't Valentine's Day such a wonderhoy event?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna make some really amazing sweets, so stay tuned, everyone! I don't know what yet... But it's gonna be really awesome!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After Emu said that, I started thinking that I should also make something.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds like something Otori would say.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I also don't really know how to bake and stuff, so I'm not sure what to do.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Isn't there a good solution out there...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... What if we made something other than sweets?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something other than sweets?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Handmade accessories or trinkets... Food's not the only way to show someone that you appreciate them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: True... That never came to mind for me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, not being limited to sweets means we might have more options available to us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, then...
What if we tried making our gifts together, Kusanagi...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Together...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I mean, it could be fun to make our gifts through some trial and error.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, of course... You don't have to if you don't want to, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh... N-No, that does sound fun.
I... I'd like to try making something with you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But what could we make?
The only things that immediately come to mind are hair accessories and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's an option. However, Saki and Honami may like that, but Shiho might not...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right... We should go for something that everyone's gonna like, but that we can manage to make...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still can't think of anything...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami probably would've already come up with something too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Yeah...
She's really good at knitting and making accessories by hand.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wow, I didn't know that...
Then, she probably would know what to do in this sort of situation.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I might just ask her for some advice now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? I thought you were gonna make something for her.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I am. However, as much as I want it to be a surprise, I'd rather give a gift that's as nice as it can be...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see... Sorry, I wish I could've come up with something...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, Kusanagi, it's okay. You don't need to apologize. Anyway, I'll try sending her a message now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Umm...
<Sorry, I know this is sudden, but there's something I need to ask you. Kusanagi and I were trying to come up with something we can make for Valentine's Day...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Do you know anything that's simple and beginner friendly...?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's kind of straight to the point, but I hope she understands...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, she's already replied.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<How about scented candles?
They're actually pretty easy to make and hard to mess up.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Scented candles...?
As in the ones that give off really nice aromas? You can make those yourself...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that could be really good since anyone we give them to can get use out of them...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You saved us, Honami. It's amazing how she can come up with an idea like this on the spot... Wait, huh...?! She keeps sending more...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... Resin jewelry, leather goods... Wow, there's so many.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, by comparison, I feel like scented candles are going to be the easiest to make and decorate.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho would also probably like that the most, so I'd like to try making some...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree...
Let's go with that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Then, I'll send Honami a reply...
<Thanks. I think we'll go with the scented candles that you first suggested.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm...? She replied back...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I think I can teach you how to make them, so how about we all do it together?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait... Honami's going to teach us...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hang on... Hoshino, that makes sense since you're her friend, but me...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's already invited you, so you should be more than welcome to join us. To put you at ease, I can ask just to be sure.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I-I'm kinda nervous... I haven't really had a chance to talk to Mochizuki before...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I want to get to know her better. I don't want to let this opportunity go to waste...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, I'd like to join you two...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Great. I'll let Honami know right now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure what we should make, but I'm glad I asked her for some advice...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(And Honami said she'd teach us...
I need to do my best with Kusanagi to make sure our scented candles turn out well!)
